page.overview:
Who is Irgain Fatamed?

Her strength in the One Power is unknown, but given the amount of time spent in training (12 years), it can be assumed that she is moderately strong and probably a middle-high ranking sister.

Irgain was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as a novice and six years as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in 958 NE.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Irgain was one of the Aes Sedai involved in kidnapping Rand. She was shielding him along with Ronaille Vevanios and Sashalle Anderly when the Battle at Dumai's Wells occurred. They were all stilled when Rand broke the shield . Irgain's two Warders were also killed during the battle. She was taken prisoner soon after by the Aiel Wise Ones. They used mild manners with her because for them her stilling was a sufficient punishment.
